name: Zeffy
description: Zeffy is a 100% free, all-in-one fundraising platform and donor CRM for nonprofits in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, and Australia. It lets organizations collect donations, sell event tickets, run raffles and auctions, manage memberships and online stores, launch peer-to-peer campaigns, and process in-person payments, without platform or transaction fees. Zeffy is funded by optional donor tips, supports major payment methods (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, ACH), and includes built-in donor management and email tools with no contact limit at any list size, helping nonprofits raise more while keeping every dollar.
